body.x: Toyota unveiled its new Fuel Cell Vehicle concept in the conference at 'CES 2014', the biggest IT∙appliances show that is held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.
In the Mandalay Bay's convention center, the prototype made its first U.S. appearance at Consumer Electronics Show here.

The Toyota FCV promises a 310 mile range between hydrogen fill-ups, room for four passengers, and a refuel time of just three minutes, but Bob Carter, Toyota senior vice president, said that cost reductions will put the car on the road.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
